findings.claim: The canonical authority page links to `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/decision-log.md` as the D1 rationale of record, but the packet's own verification states the phase control-plane files are untracked, so the link target will not exist in any committed checkout and the spec requirement 'links to its rationale' fails outside this working tree.
findings.evidence: Link hunk: `[Operator decision D1](../.kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/decision-log.md)`. verification.md states: 'The active phase control-plane files are untracked in this working tree, so Git renders the scoped `goals.md` input as a new file' — goals.md (same phase directory) appears as `new file mode 100644` in this diff, while decision-log.md is neither in the diff nor in the file tree. Spec scenario: 'THEN the authority document identifies which project decision governs active implementation and links to its rationale'.
findings.suggested_fix: Commit `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/uar-uiux-full-migration-2026-08/decision-log.md` (and the phase plan) as part of this change, or copy the D1 decision record into a tracked location under docs/ and link there.

findings.claim: This change commits the entire phase goals document (12 bullets) as a new file even though the change scope is a one-line Goal 4 amendment, so binding stack, removal-target, and exit-gate decisions enter version control without their authoring provenance, and the only provenance offered (SHA-256 of the phase plan and decision log) references untracked files no reviewer can resolve from the repository.
findings.evidence: Diff header `new file mode 100644` for goals.md containing all goal bullets; verification.md: 'C-01 did not author the other goal bullets' and 'Plan SHA-256: e1f38fcf...' / 'D1 decision-log SHA-256: 4cdab1b2...' — hashes of files that remain untracked and unverifiable from the committed tree.
findings.suggested_fix: Track the phase control-plane directory (goals, plan, decision-log) in a single preparatory commit before or alongside C-01 so the amendment is a true one-line diff and the cited hashes correspond to committed content.

findings.claim: The strict-validation and cross-model review claims are self-reported with no captured output, so acceptance criterion 2.2 ('Strictly validate the OpenSpec change and record the required refinement and review evidence') rests on unverifiable assertions within the change itself.
findings.evidence: verification.md 'Commands run' block lists `openspec validate amend-goal4-base-ui-divergence --strict` followed only by the sentence 'Both checks passed'; refinement_log.md cites 'judge `k3` (`cross_model_check: verified-distinct`)' and 'anti-theater screen passed at score `0.0`' with no transcript or log artifact committed.
findings.suggested_fix: Paste the actual validator output (or its digest) and the review transcript/artifact path into verification.md or commit them under .refiner/artifacts/ so the evidence is auditable from the repository.
